# LibreOffice Basic Macro Editor Interface

## System and Application Header

- **System Tray and Desktop Environment**
  - Top bar displays "Activities" on the left
  - System icons on the right: network, sound, and power
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 20:02"
  - Application name: "My Macros & Dialogs.Standard - LibreOffice Basic"

- **Application Menu Bar**
  - Menu options: File, Edit, View, Run, Dialog, Tools, Window, Help

## Main Interface Components

### Left Panel: Object Catalog

- **Title**: "Object Catalog"
- **Tree Structure**
  - Root: "My Macros & Dialogs"
    - Child: "Standard"
      - Child: "Module1" (highlighted in orange)
    - Child: "LibreOffice Macros & Dialogs"

### Central Editor Area

- **Code Editor**
  - **Current File**: "[My Macros & Dialogs].Standard"
  - **Code Content**
    - Line 1: "REM"
    - Line 2: "BASIC"
    - Line 3: "Sub Main"
    - Line 4: "End Sub"
    - Line 6: "Sub Macro1"
    - Line 7: "End Sub"
  - **Line Numbers**: Visible on the left side (1 to 10)
  - **Syntax Highlighting**: Keywords like "Sub" and "End Sub" are colored blue; "Macro1" is green

### Toolbar

- **Icons from left to right**
  - File operations (new, open, save, print)
  - Cut, copy, paste
  - Undo, redo
  - Macro-related icons (play, stop, step, debug)
  - Help icon (blue question mark)
  - Language selection dropdown: "<Not localized>"
  - Macro management icon (red icon with white document)

## Modal Dialog: Basic Macros

- **Title**: "Basic Macros"
- **Close Button**: Located at the top-right corner of the dialog
- **Macro Name Field**
  - Label: "Macro Name"
  - Input field: Empty
- **Macro From Tree**
  - Label: "Macro From"
  - Tree structure:
    - "My Macros" (expanded)
      - "Standard" (expanded)
        - "Module1" (highlighted in orange)
      - "LibreOffice Macros" (collapsed)
        - "Untitled 1" (collapsed)
- **Existing Macros In List**
  - Label: "Existing Macros In:"
  - List area: Empty
- **Action Buttons (Right Side)**
  - "Assign..."
  - "Edit"
  - "New"
  - "Organizer..."
- **Bottom Buttons**
  - "Help"
  - "Close"
  - "Run"

## Status and Watch Area

- **Watch Panel**
  - Label: "Watch:"
  - Input field: Empty
  - Eye icon (likely for toggling watch visibility)
- **Variable Table**
  - Columns: "Variable", "Value", "Type"
  - Content: Empty

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Navigation Controls**
  - Left arrow, right arrow, play, stop
  - Current module: "Module1"
- **Location Indicator**
  - "My Macros & Dialogs.Standard.Module1.Macro1"
  - "Ln 7, Col 1" (current cursor position)
